QUOTE: The asm path is gated by `MBEDTLS_CT_ASM`, which is defined only when `MBEDTLS_HAVE_ASM` is on and `__GNUC__` or `__ARMCC_VERSION` is defined.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says MBEDTLS_CT_ASM is defined from MBEDTLS_HAVE_ASM plus compiler predefined macros. It also says there is "no configuration check", which implies it isn't set in mbedtls_config.h.
